message.content:
{
  "screen_decision": "include",
  "screen_rationale": "The study quantifies the correlation between in vitro drug response metrics from their HuP3D model and clinical effective concentrations (Css), reporting that 8 out of 10 HuP3D metrics showed a significant and strong correlation (r > 0.5). This directly measures the agreement between animal model (in vitro model in this case) and human clinical outcomes.",
  "arm": "efficacy",
  "arm_evidence": "A significant and strong correlation with the clinical effective concentration in patients was found for eight out of ten of the HuP3D metrics, revealing HuP3D cultures as a feasible and efficacious technique to predict clinically effective therapies better than current preclinical models.",
  "therapeutic_areas": [
    "oncology"
  ],
  "areas_evidence": "Breast cancer (BCa) is a heterogeneous disease, which includes different biological entities characterized by distinct clinical behaviors and responses to treatment.",
  "model_type": "in-vitro-or-in-silico-comparator",
  "model_evidence": "Human plasma-derived 3D culture (HuP3D) is a physiological, patient-derived, tumor-like 3D culture method that supports the efficient growth and expansion of BCa cell lines and primary breast cancer tumors, as well as allowing for the screening of cancer drug responses in BCa cell lines and primary BCa tumors.",
  "species": [
    "not-species-specific"
  ],
  "species_evidence": "The study focuses on human plasma-derived 3D cultures and human breast cancer cell lines, and compares their drug response metrics to human clinical data. No specific animal species are mentioned as being used in the primary experiments.",
  "endpoint_class": "mixed",
  "endpoint_evidence": "The study calculates various drug metrics including IC50, EC50, Emax, AUC, Einf, GR50, GEC50, GRmax, GRAOC, and GRinf, which encompass both direct measures of cell count reduction (primary-hard) and growth rate inhibition (secondary-biomarker)."
}
